title: 'Team-in-the-loop': Ostrom's IAD framework ‘rules in use' to map and measure contextual impacts of Al
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement; it proposes a theoretical framework for analyzing the contextual impacts of AI. There is no measurement related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith.
